cells.gaps: No source found says a route that avoids Cameroon is in service. The minister told PP-26 in November 2026 that three links with Cameroon and Sudan are completed (TCD-010), but Southwood the same month says the Port Sudan link ended in 2023 (TCD-009) and the minister said in October 2026 that only one access, via Cameroon, is active (TCD-002). No high-capacity cable is known to carry Chad's traffic.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13: the minister's PP-26 statement that links with Cameroon and Sudan are completed does not say the Sudan link is in service, against two sources saying it is not (TCD-009, TCD-002); two routes through Cameroon to Kribi (TCD-009, TCD-007) hold the cell at 3.
